The directional arrow points somewhere between obvious and misleading on most days. Players consistently overshoot adjacent nations because shared borders create similar silhouettes. Spain looks like Portugal from certain angles. Austria resembles Switzerland. Your brain wants to match the unknown shape to something familiar, and neighbors fill that role too well.

The fix is counterintuitive: ignore the border entirely on your second guess. Pick something in the same region but not adjacent. If you guessed France, don't follow up with Belgium or Germany. Try Italy or Spain. This forces the distance percentage to do real work instead of confirming a border you'd already ruled out.
